# Video Editing Studio dependencies

- Mediabunny 1.66.1 by Vanilagy. The upstream browser bundle is included verbatim at
  `client/vendor/mediabunny.mjs`. The corresponding TypeScript source is in the
  [same npm release archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.66.1.tgz)
  under `package/src/`. [MPL-2.0 license](mediabunny/LICENSE).
- `client/glyph-pop.mjs` comes from the user's local video-production skill, in
  `assets/motion-presets/glyph-pop.mjs`. The preview and encoder sample it at the clip's local time.
